office: the Passport Office, St Peter Port (the States of Guernsey)

routes.label: standard service: currently up to 3 weeks, subject to delivery

note: Fees from 1 September 2026. Someone born on or before 2 September 1929 gets a standard passport free. The passports are printed in the United Kingdom and sent by Royal Mail; the office can't send them overseas.

sources.title: States of Guernsey (gov.gg), Passports
sources.said: Passport Fees (w.e.f 01/09/2026) Standard Adult (aged 16 or over) 10 year passport £115.50 Standard Child (aged under 16) 5 year passport £80.00 ... If you were born on or before 2 September 1929 you can get a free, standard (32 page, 10 year) passport. ... How long does it take? Standard service It is currenctly taking up to 3 weeks to process passport applications.
